title: Per-route/model/region Latency Orchestrator and Anomaly Watcher (p95/p99 + tokens/sec)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We currently surface p95/p99 and throughput signals in several dashboards, but lack a single orchestrated view that correlates tail latency with tokens/sec and model variant by region and route. This makes it slow to diagnose regressions caused by workload shifts (longer sequences, token bursts) or model changes.

Goal: Ship an "Orchestrator" telemetry and dashboard set that: 1) emits p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per (route, model_version, region, instance_type) at 1m and 5m rollups, 2) builds delta baselines and anomaly scores (regression detection), and 3) provides interactive dashboards and alert rules to reduce mean time to detect/regress by >50% for tail-latency incidents.
proposal: 1) Define metric schema and exporter changes to tag every inference request with route, model_version, region, region_zone, token_count, and synthetic_flag. 2) Add continuous aggregators to compute p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec (both raw and normalized by concurrent active_sessions). 3) Implement a lightweight Orchestrator service that computes rolling baselines per slice and emits anomaly signals (score + reason). 4) Build a set of dashboards: heatmap, slice comparison, token-rate vs latency scatter, and a replayable request playback panel for reproductions. 5) Wire alerts (anomaly score threshold + sustained increase in p99) into PagerDuty and the Console incident panel.
telemetry_schema:
Emit the following metrics (per minute):
- inference.requests.count (tags: route, model_version, region, zone, instance_type, synthetic)
- inference.tokens.total (same tags)
- inference.latency.histogram (buckets, tags) and derived p50/p95/p99 (tags)
- inference.concurrent.sessions (tags)
- orchestrator.anomaly.score (tags: route, model_version, region, detector_version)
Retention/rollups: 1m raw for 30d, 5m aggregates for 90d, 1h for 1y. All tags are required for slice identity; missing tags are grouped under "unknown".
dashboards:
Deliverables: 
- 'Orchestrator Overview' (global) with top-20 worst slices (p99 change %, tokens/sec change %), current anomalies list, and quick links to slice detail.
- 'Slice Detail' (route+model+region) showing time-series for p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, active_sessions, and request rate; correlation scatter of tokens/sec vs latency; YAML snippet of last 3 sample requests for quick repro.
- 'Heatmap Matrix' with routes on Y, models on X and cell = p99 delta over baseline for selected region/time.
- 'Synthetic Playback' dashboard to trigger and visualize synthetic load for a slice and compare to baseline traces.
Each dashboard has exportable CSV and direct-linkable view for runbooks and on-call ops.
alerting_rules:
Primary alerts: 
- ORCH-ANOMALY-1: orchestrator.anomaly.score > 0.7 for > 5m for a single slice -> Pages SRE.
- ORCH-P99-SUSTAINED: p99 > baseline + 30% for > 10m across >=3 hosts in region -> P1 incident.
- ORCH-TOKEN-RATE-SPIKE: tokens/sec increase > 3x baseline and correlated p95 increase > 25% -> create investigation ticket and mute transient spikes.
Alert payload includes slice tags, recent sample requests (anonymized), and link to replay and correlated logs.
regression_detection: Approach: Use dual detectors - lightweight EWMA + CUSUM for fast signal, and a weekly spectral change detector for slow drifts. Baseline defined as rolling 14-day median with hour-of-day/day-of-week seasonality adjustments. When both detectors agree and anomaly score exceeds threshold, mark as 'regression' and attach confidence. We store detector_version so regressions can be audited. Provide auto-suppression for known rollout windows (release tags) and integrate with Canary rollout metadata to avoid noisy pages.
synthetic_harness_plan: Enhancements to existing synthetic harness: allow per-slice token-length distributions (sampled from production), spike profiles (burst, ramp, sustained), and concurrency ramps. Add a 'replay with KV cache warmup' mode to evaluate cache-sensitive flows. Synthetic runs write a structured artifact (trace + sample requests + aggregated metrics) that the dashboard 'Synthetic Playback' can load for side-by-side comparison with production baseline.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (week 1-2): metric schema changes and 1m exporters, aggregator job + test dashboard for a small set of 10 high-traffic routes in us-west-2.
Phase 2 (week 3): Orchestrator detector v1 and overview dashboard; enable alerts for non-prod and internal infra teams.
Phase 3 (week 4): Expand to all routes and regions, enable PD paging for SRE, add synthetic playback integration.
Rollback: quick revert of detector scoring and alert rules; metrics continue to be emitted without orchestrator scoring.
acceptance_criteria:
1) p95/p99 + tokens/sec metrics available per (route, model_version, region) for the pilot routes with consistent tags.
2) Dashboards populated and loadable within Console (no more than 8s render for overview).
3) Orchestrator anomaly signals accurately reproduce known injected regressions in synthetic runs (true positive rate >= 90%, false positive rate <= 5% on held-out stable slices).
4) PagerDuty alerts fire on pilot regressions and include reproducible links + sample requests.
5) On-call runbook updated with playbook for 'Orchestrator p99 regression'.
progress_updates: 2026-03-05: Ticket created by Asha with initial scope and goals.
2026-03-06: Telemetry schema draft circulated; feedback from infra: add concurrent_sessions and instance_type tag.
2026-03-08: Prototype aggregator implemented in staging for 3 routes; p95/p99 values appear in metrics backend.
2026-03-11: Detector PoC (EWMA+CUSUM) validated against synthetic regressions; tuning required for seasonality windows.
2026-03-12: Dashboard wireframes uploaded; assigned Miguel for implementation and infra setup for aggregator cluster.
notes: Trade-offs considered: store precomputed percentiles vs compute on-demand. We chose precomputed 1m rollups to keep dashboard latency low at the cost of storage. We will periodically evaluate moving heavy slices to on-demand fast-query paths using an indexer. Privacy: sample requests are scrubbed (PII redaction) before being stored; synthetic runs can include original request payloads by opt-in only.
implementation_tasks: Add exporter tags: route, model_version, zone, instance_type, synthetic_flag
Aggregator job: compute p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec at 1m/5m windows
Orchestrator service: detector pipeline and anomaly store
Dashboards: overview, slice-detail, heatmap, synthetic playback
Alerts: implement rules and incident payload enrichment
Synthetic harness: token-length distributions and replay mode
